column1: #Text=Can you describe the content of this map?
#Text=Fragment of Long Island with the town of Montauk and Fort Pond Lake in the center of the map.
#Text=In the northwest corner and southeast corner, the Atlantic Ocean.
#Text=In the northeast corner, part of a state park, Montauk Downs Park.
#Text=The rest of the peninsula is built up.
#Text=A main road crosses the peninsula from west to east, passing south of Montauk and Fort Pond Lake.
#Text=A few hotels and restaurants are marked.
#Text=The south of the peninsula has a large beach along the entire coastline.
